intro: Here lies Tieion, an ancient city in Zonguldak province whose story runs from the 7th century BC to the 5th century AD. It was a port city at Filyos, and its name has survived unchanged since antiquity.
history: Founded by Milesian colonists in the 7th century BC, the city grew as a port on the border of Paphlagonia and Bithynia. The city Pliny called 'Tios' lives on today in Filyos.
structure-1: You are now at Filyos Castle, the castle that guarded Tieion's harbour at Filyos.
structure-3: Now look at the aqueducts, built in the Roman era to carry water to the city.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the Ancient Theatre and the Bath, and follow the line of the City Walls.
facts: Did you know? Tieion is one of the rare Anatolian cities that carried its ancient name to the present day. This city at Filyos is among the least excavated on the Black Sea coast, and its theatre has only recently been uncovered. Ancient sources say it took its name from a priest, Tios, and that it was the smallest independent city in the region.
outro: This brings our tour of Tieion to an end. Before you go, please leave the stones untouched, keep to the marked paths and carry water with you. Enjoy your visit.
